name: color-picker
title: Color picker
description: Any color, chosen on a field of lightness and chroma, a hue and an opacity, or typed.
use: A color the reader may choose freely, such as a brand color, a label's color or a theme token. It chooses in OKLCH, so lightness and chroma move as the eye sees them, and it writes the color in hex, rgb() or oklch(). Inline, or opened from a button in a popover.

instead.when: The color is one of a few the page offers
The platform's own picker is enough, with no opacity and no OKLCH

keyboard.action: On the field's thumb, make the color lighter or darker by 1% of lightness
On the field's thumb, add or take away .005 of chroma, toward the end of the line or its start (mirrored right to left)
On the field's thumb, ten times the step: 10% of lightness or .05 of chroma
On the field's thumb, make the color lighter or darker by 10% of lightness
On the field's thumb, take the chroma to none (a grey) or to the end of the field

keyboard.keys: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown
keyboard.action: On the hue and the opacity, what the native range input does
In the text field, take what is typed; the field is written again in the format chosen, or put back when it is not a color

platform.feature: oklch() and gradients interpolated in Oklab
platform.fallback: Supported in all current browsers. An older one leaves the field and the tracks unpainted; the text field still takes and writes the color

platform.feature: The popover attribute and CSS anchor positioning
platform.fallback: Opened from a button, the picker is a popover: without anchor positioning it opens centered, as the browser places any popover

classes.name: color-picker
classes.description: The picker: a column 16rem wide of the field, the tracks and the text. When it holds a color-picker-popover it holds only the button and the popover, which takes the column

classes.name: color-picker-area
classes.description: The field: lightness from 100% at the top to 0 at the bottom, chroma from 0 to .37 along the line, at the hue held. It holds the thumb and takes the pointer

classes.name: color-picker-thumb
classes.description: The one thumb of the field, placed from the numbers on the root: a slider whose value is the lightness and whose aria-valuetext names the lightness and the chroma

classes.name: color-picker-hue
classes.description: On a slider from 0 to 360: the hue, on a track painted with the circle of hues

classes.name: color-picker-alpha
classes.description: On a slider from 0 to 100: the opacity, on a track where the color fades in over a checker. Leave it out for an opaque color

classes.name: color-picker-swatch
classes.description: On a swatch: the color held, over a checker. In the column it stands at the start of the two tracks; in the button that opens a popover it shows the color while the picker is closed

classes.name: color-picker-fields
classes.description: The row of the format and the text

classes.name: color-picker-format
classes.description: On a small select: the format the text is written in, with the options hex, rgb and oklch

classes.name: color-picker-text
classes.description: On a small text field: the color, written in the format chosen. It takes a color typed in any of the three, and carries the name a form submits

classes.name: color-picker-popover
classes.description: On a popover inside the root: the column, opened from a button beside it, whose swatch shows the color

states.name: disabled
states.description: The field fades and takes no pointer and no key, and the behavior takes the thumb out of the tab order with tabindex="-1" until it is enabled again; disable the sliders and the fields beside it

properties.name: --color-picker-lightness
properties.description: The color's lightness, from 0 to 1. The behavior writes it on the root; write the first value in the markup's style

properties.name: --color-picker-chroma
properties.description: The color's chroma, from 0; the field reaches .37

properties.name: --color-picker-hue
properties.description: The color's hue, in degrees without a unit

properties.name: --color-picker-color
properties.description: The color held, made from the four numbers: read it for anything else inside the root that shows the color
